name: web-forager
description: Clean-room, robots-aware web information gathering for agents and analysts. HTTP mode searches 360/Bing/Sogou/WeChat, searches inside a site through its own search page, reads HTML/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/EPUB/CSV and RSS/Atom, collects public pages from Bilibili through a dedicated adapter and reads other sites as ordinary pages, extracts metadata and tables, discovers sitemaps and caches politely. Browser mode drives a real browser through a pluggable bridge for login-state pages, rendered content, danmaku and seven read-only playbooks covering Bilibili, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu. Optional scholarly lookups cover arXiv/Crossref/PubMed/DOI. Ships a CLI, an --agent envelope, and two stdio MCP servers.
